description: Put the line on Nick's chest, and stopped Sam after one thick note.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Walked three paces and stood by the pillar.
name: John Sincler

description: Held the two beats and spoke "Dead for my life."
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Cleared Sincler's line and took the twelvemonth plain.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Sang the word through a thick throat, and did not get a second try.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Set Nick's two beats, asked for the plain voice, and left the new page at home.
name: William Shakespeare
